issues.doc: Penal Code 1987 · federal_decree_law_no_33 (EN) · مرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم (33) (AR) — low_content_density gate cluster
issues.symptom: Tree collapsed to ERROR via low_content_density gate (chars_per_node 408.2/54.3/459.4 vs threshold 500) across 3 previously-passing large documents; systemic over-segmentation or gate computation change suspected, not 3 independent failures
issues.start_tracing_from: md_to_tree, _extract_markers (check for node-count/over-segmentation drift) and the low_content_density gate computation itself

issues.doc: اتفاقية مستوى الخدمة (SLA) · مرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم (13) — total content loss, empty trees persisted
issues.symptom: 0 nodes / 0 chars persisted for both docs (flat.json exists with 0 blocks); body-extraction step silently returns empty and the pipeline saves it anyway, violating Hard Rule 5 (never silently persist a low-quality tree)
issues.start_tracing_from: pdf_to_markdown_docling, _maybe_splice_picture_ocr, and the validate_tree/save_doc gate that should have rejected a 0-node tree

issues.doc: MOU MOHRE & Nafis & وزارة الصناعة والتكنولوجيا المتقدمة (1).pdf — 89% content loss + garble gate misfire
issues.symptom: chars collapsed 13,564 -> 1,487 (preamble only, ~89% loss) while the garble gate simultaneously misreports ratio=1.00 with 0 actual garbled sequences on clean Arabic text
issues.start_tracing_from: pdf_to_markdown_docling / Arabic-mixed block handling, and garble gate functions (_probe_text_layer) for the ratio miscomputation

issues.doc: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (106) لسنة 2022 — mid-document truncation
issues.symptom: Extraction truncated starting at Article 4 and ending abruptly; 179->11 nodes, 26,027->2,022 chars (~92% loss), new truncation not present in Run 12

issues.doc: وارد رقم 597 من مكتب أبوظبي التنفيذي — pipeline timeout/hang, never persisted
issues.symptom: Job no longer completes at all: Run 12 persisted a defective FAIL artifact, Run 13 returns NoSuchKey/ERROR (never persisted); suspected timeout/hang on the 42-page scanned Arabic OCR path introduced by a garble-gate or OCR-escalation change
issues.start_tracing_from: _run_converter_subprocess, arq job handler, and worker/job timeout configuration

issues.doc: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (1) لسنة 2022 — masked content-loss regression behind stable MARGINAL verdict
issues.symptom: chars fell 48,050 -> 14,865 (~69% loss, live-verified), nodes 349 -> 129; verdict stayed MARGINAL in both runs, masking a real extraction collapse

issues.doc: Reitlehrer - Schäden am Berittpferd.pdf — picture-enrichment regression
issues.symptom: chars dropped ~32% (4,082 -> 2,768) with identical node count; a previously-benign unenriched image (node 3.5, judged a logo) is now flagged as missing content, suggesting text derived from/alongside that image was lost

issues.doc: سياسة حوكمة و إدارة البيانات - Copy.pdf — RTL title-reversal blind spot
issues.symptom: 23/24 node titles are fully character-reversed (RTL bug) while body text is correct; the garble gate only inspects body text and never the title field, so this defect class is structurally invisible to quality checks across runs
issues.start_tracing_from: _probe_text_layer and garble gate functions — confirm title field is excluded from garble scanning

issues.doc: Federal Decree-Law 47 · Haftpflicht-Allgemeine · pie-chart JPG — verdict downgrades on (near-)identical live metrics
issues.symptom: PASS->MARGINAL/FAIL verdict swings on byte-identical or near-identical extraction metrics (new node-ordering check, depth-adequacy scrutiny, RTL/truncation scrutiny); also reconcile with the broader stored-vs-judged verdict divergence noted in Pre-publish Verification item 8 (6 docs stored PASS vs judged MARGINAL, 2 stored MARGINAL vs judged FAIL)
